purpose: Certificate for proof.md section 2.4 (D1): no k with 1 <= k < 2^50 and 2^k in Gamma (mod r), for the secp256k1 order r. Exact, with no assumption beyond the arithmetic.

method.algorithm: baby-step giant-step over the exponent k = i*m + j, m = 2^25, 0 <= i, j < m, covering 0 <= k < m^2 = 2^50 exactly once per k
method.baby_table: all 2^j mod r for 0 <= j < m, open addressing with 2m slots, keyed by a 64-bit fingerprint of the full 256-bit value; every entry kept, including fingerprint collisions
method.giant_steps: for each g in Gamma and each 0 <= i < m: h_i = g * (2^-m)^i mod r; a match h_i = 2^j means 2^(i*m+j) = g
method.exactness: a true match has equal fingerprints (the fingerprint is a function of the value), so a probe with no equal fingerprint proves no match: no false negatives. Every fingerprint match is verified on the full value; a verified match is then checked again by 2^k mod r = g
method.special_cases: k = 0 (i = j = 0, the element 1) is skipped; equal baby values with different j would mean ord_r(2) < m and are counted (none)

machine: Apple silicon (Darwin), single process, GMP via Homebrew, cc (clang)
limits: exact for the stated range; it certifies D1 only for escape depths below 2^50 (proof.md section 2.3)
